channel.title: Veerachit Jaruthanadech: Thoughts
channel.description: Essays by Veerachit Jaruthanadech (วีรชิต จารุธนเดช) on AI in real operations, brand, and running companies from Bangkok.

item.title: AI ช่วยพิสูจน์สมมติฐานรีมันน์ได้แล้ว นี่คือ Singularity หรือยัง
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: โจทย์อายุ 167 ปีถูกปิดลงด้วยคนหนึ่งคนกับ AI หนึ่งตัว บทเรียนสำหรับธุรกิจไม่ใช่เรื่องซูเปอร์อินเทลลิเจนซ์ แต่อยู่ที่ว่างานไหนตรวจคำตอบได้

item.title: Ask a Machine Who You Are
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: Long before any singularity, AI has become the first reader of your company. It can only repeat what it can read and connect.

item.title: The Company of 2040
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: Everyone will rent the same intelligence. The company of 2040 will be defined by what it refuses to delegate.

item.title: องค์กรไทยต้องปรับตัวอย่างไรในยุค AI ปี 2027: เมื่อ Branding และ AI Transformation เป็นเรื่องเดียวกัน
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: องค์กรไทยใช้ AI เร็วขึ้นมาก แต่ส่วนใหญ่ยังอยู่ระดับพื้นฐาน ปี 2027 จะแยกองค์กรที่ทำเป็นออกจากองค์กรที่แค่มีเครื่องมือ

item.title: Singularity คืออะไร และธุรกิจไทยควรเตรียมตัวอย่างไร
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: ไม่มีใครรู้วันที่ แต่คำถามที่ธุรกิจต้องตอบพรุ่งนี้เช้าชัดอยู่แล้ว

item.title: The Case for Boring AI
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: The AI that changes a company most is often one short message a day.

item.title: Where AI Systems Actually Break
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: Not in the model. In the quiet shared parts everything else is waiting on.

item.title: Label It by Hand First
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: Before you automate customer feedback, read it yourself. The categories you need are not obvious.

item.title: Why Leaders Should Go Back to Class on AI
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: Daily AI use builds deep but uneven knowledge. A structured course shows leaders where they have been guessing.

item.title: Headcount Is No Longer the Unit
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: For decades, companies were sized by how many people they took. That number is losing its meaning.

item.title: Taste Is the Last Moat
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: When everyone can generate, the only thing left to compete on is knowing what is good.

item.title: Give Your Company a Memory
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: The jump is rarely a smarter model. It is the day the system stops forgetting.

item.title: The Edit Is the Work
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: Good work is not about what you add. It is about what survives the cut.

item.title: Why AI Won't Replace the Brief
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: Every tool that changed how people work has one thing in common. It still needs a question.

item.title: Premium Is a Decision
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: Premium is not a price point. It is a decision, made early and defended when it is expensive.

item.title: Claypot and Code
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: A claypot kitchen and an AI practice face the same question: what to preserve when everything moves fast.

item.title: Bangkok and Hong Kong Are Not the Same City
item.dc:creator: Veerachit Jaruthanadech
item.description: One city moves fast and trusts instinct. The other moves fast and demands proof. Both are right.
